Accounts::summary() looks an account up by user and requires exactly one acct record; the alternative domain/search/searchmethod/searchtype lookups are not implemented (use call()), so the variant stays partial. Read-only GET execution with WHM-token authentication; the live test declarations exercise the operation on test.oblak.host without saved revision-bound outcomes.

Accounts::changePackage() sends user and pkg. The pinned GET contract's parameters are sent as an application/x-www-form-urlencoded POST body so passwords and other parameters never reach the URL that the pinned WHM documentation says the server records in its access log; the lifecycle live test is approval-gated (group live-mutating) and has no saved revision-bound outcome. Parameter validation conditions remain upstream API decisions.

Accounts::create() sends the username and every documented option unchanged and returns the optional nameserver/package strings from data.
